exams.name: Independent Adjuster Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of lines of authority, duties and responsibilities of an independent adjuster, and insurance laws and rules of Alabama. After failing twice, must wait 3 months; after failing two more times, must wait 6 months.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under rules prescribed by the commissioner, may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: An individual intending to apply for an independent adjuster license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to Section 27-9A-9.

interval_years.quote: An independent adjuster license shall be initially renewed in accordance with a schedule prescribed by the commissioner and shall thereafter be subject to renewal on a biennial basis.

required.quote: An individual who holds an independent adjuster license and who is not exempt under subsection (b) shall satisfactorily complete a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education courses as may be approved by the commissioner, of which three hours must be in ethics, reported to the commissioner on a biennial basis in conjunction with the license renewal cycle.

available.quote: Unless refused licensure pursuant to Section 27-9A-12, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident independent adjuster license if: (1) The person is currently licensed in good standing as an independent adjuster in the resident or home state of the person.

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed in good standing in home state, apply and pay fees, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Alabama residents on the same basis. Business entities must also qualify or register with the Secretary of State.
requirements.quote: The person's designated home state awards nonresident independent adjuster licenses to persons of this state on the same basis.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or registration through misrepresentation or fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an independent adjuster license, company or employee adjuster license, public adjuster license, emergency adjuster license or registration or its equivalent, or insurance producer license or its equivalent suspended, revoked, or refused in any other state, province, district, or territory.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating, including improperly using notes or any other reference material, to complete an examination for a license.

definition_quote.value: an 'independent adjuster' is a person who, for compensation as an independent contractor or as an employee of an independent contractor, undertakes on behalf of an insurer to ascertain and determine the amount of any claim, loss, or damage payable under a contract of property, casualty, or workers' compensation insurance or to effect settlement of such claim, loss, or damage.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: Has designated an individual independent adjuster licensed in this state as responsible for the business entity's compliance with this chapter and with the insurance laws and rules of this state.

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: the commissioner may require fingerprints of applicants and to submit the fingerprints and the fee required to perform the criminal history record checks to the Alabama Department of Public Safety and the Federal Bureau of Investigation for state and national criminal history record checks.

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: Not have any financial interest in any adjustment or acquire any interest or title in salvage without first receiving written authority from the principal.

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: a person may, in the sole discretion of the commissioner after a hearing, additionally be subject to a civil fine in an amount not to exceed ten thousand dollars ($10,000) per violation.
